source: WHO Disease Outbreak News 1996 Global Cholera Update
processing_notes: Source states: 'a cholera outbreak which started in September 1995 caused 2027 cases and 150 deaths up to 12 November 1995. Cases were subsequently reported in Département de Nord and most recently in Département du Centre and Département du Sud.' - interpreted as 2027 sCh cases 150 deaths. source: WHO Disease Outbreak News 2001 Cholera in West Africa

source: WHO Disease Outbreak News 2002 Cholera in Côte d'Ivoire
processing_notes: Source states: 'As of 14 July 2002 the Ministry of Health reported a total of 581 cases with 19 deaths (case-fatality rate of 3.27%) since the beginning of the year. Laboratory confirmed Vibrio cholerae El Tor by Institut Pasteur Abidjan.' - interpreted as 581 sCh 19 deaths as of mid-year 2002. JHU baseline shows full year 4188 cases/143 deaths.

processing_notes: Source states: 'cholera broke out in Abidjan neighborhood of Adjamé in late January 2011 claiming seven deaths. By January 31 the outbreak had killed eight people of 41 infected. source: Africanews Report Ivory Coast Cholera Outbreak June 2025
processing_notes: Source states: '45 cases have been recorded in Vridi Akobrate in the outskirts of Abidjan the capital including seven fatalities. Daniel Kouadio Ekra head of National Institute of Public Hygiene confirmed epidemic after stool sample analyses by Institut Pasteur CIV detected cholera vibrio. - interpreted as 45 sCh 7 deaths initial outbreak period. First cholera in CIV after approximately 15 years absence.
